summary: Lufax Holding filed a 6-K attaching an HKEX announcement covering (1) renewal of continuing connected transactions with controlling shareholder Ping An (which indirectly holds ~66.85%) under several 2026 framework agreements for a two-year term from January 1, 2027 to December 31, 2028, plus a new 2027 Account Management Framework Agreement with Ping An Property Casualty, and (2) the record date for an extraordinary general meeting. These are routine related-party renewals and meeting logistics, not a special situation; no deal terms, no change of control, no capital action. Watch only for independent shareholder approval mechanics and caps.
